newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn cattle market lightly tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn cattle market lightly tested - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers not well tested, compared with Thursday's close, USDA said. Trade slow. Demand moderate. Seller interest light.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
